1.name: diana reviews cue sheet
1.description: Diana stands center stage with a red clipboard, scanning a cue sheet and tapping her pen, establishing her focused control over the rehearsal.
evidence: DIANA CRANE (40s, razor-focused, dark blazer) stands center stage gripping a RED CLIPBOARD, scanning a cue sheet. Her pen taps a fast rhythm against the board.

1.name: leon requests blocking change
1.description: Leon enters with his arm in a cast and asks Diana to revisit the Act Two blocking because the cast's movement feels wrong.
evidence: Enter LEON MARSH (30s, tall, effortlessly magnetic) from stage left. His LEFT ARM is in a white plaster CAST from wrist to elbow. He carries his script in his right hand.

LEON
Diana. Can we revisit the Act Two blocking? The cast makes the movement feel wrong.

1.name: diana redirects leon to priya
1.description: Diana dismisses Leon's concern as a prop issue and tells him to take it up with Priya.
evidence:
DIANA
Prop issue. Talk to Priya.

1.name: priya responds to summons
1.description: Priya emerges from the wings with her work gear and asks what the problem is after hearing her name.
evidence: PRIYA NAIR (20s, efficient, quick-moving) appears from the wings. She wears a YELLOW LANYARD looped around her neck -- keys, radio fob, and access cards dangling from it. She carries a tablet.

PRIYA
I heard my name. What is the disaster?

1.name: leon downplays problem
1.description: Leon reframes the issue for Priya as an adjustment rather than a disaster.
evidence:
LEON
Not a disaster. An adjustment.

1.name: oscar arrives with briefcase
1.description: Oscar enters from the house, climbs onto the stage, and places his worn leather briefcase on a prop table.
evidence: OSCAR VANE (60s, silver-haired, deliberate) enters from the back of the house carrying a worn LEATHER BRIEFCASE. He climbs the stage stairs and sets it on a prop table.

1.name: oscar presses group to work
1.description: Oscar challenges the group by asking whether they are actually working or merely talking about it.
evidence:
OSCAR
Are we working or discussing working?

1.name: diana assigns scene nine revision
1.description: Diana tells Oscar she needs him working on the Scene Nine revision.
evidence:
DIANA
Both, apparently. Oscar, I need you on the Scene Nine revision.

1.name: oscar opens annotated script
1.description: Oscar opens his briefcase to reveal a thick script heavily marked in three colors of ink, signaling active revision work.
evidence: Oscar opens his leather briefcase. Inside: the thick script, marked in three colors of ink.

1.name: diana calls four oclock run-through
1.description: Diana announces a full run-through at four and checks that everyone is ready.
evidence:
DIANA (CONT'D)
(to the room)
Full run-through at four. Everyone ready.
